about_the_game:
Welcome to the CSCD: Vietnam Mobile Police Demo!

We’re excited to present the first demo version of CSCD: Vietnam Mobile Police! This demo offers you a unique glimpse into the core elements of our game, including:

  • Immersive Vietnamese Environment: Explore "Khuong Binh Street," a vast combat zone filled with diverse spaces, creating countless tactical opportunities for combat.

  • Dynamic Gunplay: Experience a variety of shooting techniques that enhance your combat style—whether it's quick aim, deep aim, free aim, blind fire, or canted aim.

  • Challenging AI Opponents: Face off against highly skilled AI that moves fluidly and uses weapons effectively, providing a tough challenge in every encounter.

  • Team Control: While this feature is still in development, basic team commands are available to help you position your squad effectively to complete missions.

  • Team Management System: Organize your squad, recruit new soldiers, and manage your arsenal and weapon accessories.

  • Weapon Customization: Customize your weapons to suit your combat style, enhancing your strategy in the field.

Mission Objective

In this demo, your mission is to "Find and Eliminate" all enemies in the combat zone. Get ready for action!

Tips for a Better Experience

  • Stay Alert: The agile AI can appear anywhere in the combat zone, making it essential to stay vigilant. Be prepared for unexpected engagements!

  • Position Your Teammates Wisely: Strategically positioning your squad for defense is crucial. Enemies might flank your team and launch surprise attacks, which can lead to serious casualties.

  • Team member roles: While team member roles are introduced, they currently have no effects on gameplay. Look forward to more detailed mechanics in future updates!

  • Choose Wisely: Selecting the right weapons and accessories, along with adapting your aiming techniques, can significantly enhance your performance in battle.

  • Stay Tactical: Engage the enemies with the seriousness of a real battle. They are aggressive and resilient, and you’ll need to make strong efforts to minimize casualties.

  • Expect Imperfections: As a demo version, there may be bugs and incomplete features. Our development team is committed to addressing these issues and will continue to enhance the game in future updates!

Thank you for trying out the demo! We hope you enjoy your experience in CSCD: Vietnam Mobile Police and look forward to your feedback.

content_descriptors.notes: Law enforcement officers engaged and neutralized dangerous criminal suspects, potentially in a scenario involving hostages and fatalities.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 or above
  • Processor: CPU with SSE2 instruction support
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 / Shader Model 4.0 compatible (GeForce 8 series, Radeon HD 2000 series, Intel GMA X3500, or newer)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Step into the boots of the elite Mobile Police force in CSCD, a gripping tactical shooter. Defend the nation, uphold justice, and experience the intensity of modern law enforcement in Vietnam. Prepare to serve, protect, and preserve peace.
